name: @nuri/playground
description: Nuri playground · the build-free bench. A SEPARATE area from the DS docs (decision 57): a fixed light+cream surface where real screen compositions render live to validate the design system on real layouts. Consumer of @nuri/prototype (the build-free components it embeds) and @nuri/spec (the token cake). decision 68 · convergence phase 2 (A5).
//: build-free HTML — NO build/test script. Pages render by opening the file (no dev server): pages/index.html plus the component/screen documents under pages/ using lib/shell.{css,js}. Cross-package assets resolve via workspace-relative paths (the token cake + active components → ../../prototype). DAG: playground → prototype → spec (NEVER → doc — doc is a consumer). The phase-6 home for rebuilt product-like demos.
